cards.title: Start here
cards.body:
Free Roblox assets for developers and their AI agents. Start with editable UI kits.

1. Read <#1566966690649083927>.
2. Grab a kit from <#1566966693727699087>.
3. Tell us what you are building in <#1566964412928233636>.

Share your work in <#1566970205513453709> or request a UI in <#1566966905204506648>. Choose optional pings in Channels & Roles.

cards.title: Rules
cards.body:
1. Respect other people. No harassment, hate speech, or sexual content.

2. Keep posts relevant. No spam, unsolicited advertising, or mass mentions.

3. Share only work and references you have permission to share. No leaked paid assets, malicious files, or requests for passwords and tokens.

4. Use the right channel. Keep feedback useful and about the work, not the person.

5. UI requests need a screenshot of every frame or panel you want copied and a full walkthrough video showing animations and interactions. Incomplete references may be sent back.

6. Follow moderator directions. Report problems privately to the server owner rather than starting an argument.

cards.title: Announcements
cards.body:
Kit releases and community announcements live here.

Choose optional pings in Channels & Roles: UI releases, Model releases, VFX releases, Luau releases, Community updates, or Events.

We use the relevant topic role for updates. You can change your choices at any time.

Browse the kits on [GitHub](https://github.com/imafreakandyalldontknowit67/steal-a-template).

cards.title: The library
cards.body:
The assets live on [GitHub](https://github.com/imafreakandyalldontknowit67/steal-a-template). Browse the catalog, pick a UI kit, and follow its README.

Download the RBXM and drag it into Roblox Studio. If its ScreenGui is outside StarterGui, move it there. If it is already there, leave it in place. Import one copy.

Working with an AI agent? Use the repository installation instructions and give it the kit name or pack link.

Show your changes in <#1566970205513453709> or report a kit issue in <#1566966709355806911>.

cards.title: What are you building?
cards.body:
Tell us what you are building and what you want to make next.

Ask setup questions, compare approaches, and help another developer. Work in progress is welcome.

Share your project in <#1566970205513453709>. Found a kit issue? Use <#1566966709355806911>.

cards.title: Suggest an improvement
cards.body:
Describe the problem, who it affects, and the improvement you want. Keep one suggestion per message.

Have a fix, cleanup, or improvement to the repository? Open a [pull request](https://github.com/imafreakandyalldontknowit67/steal-a-template/pulls) with what changed and how you checked it.

For a UI recreation, use <#1566966905204506648> with a full walkthrough video and a screenshot of every frame or panel you want copied.

cards.title: Report a kit issue
cards.body:
Include:

Kit name and version, release, or commit
Download or pack link
Steps to reproduce
Expected result and actual result
Studio errors and relevant logs
Device, viewport, and input method
Screenshots or video showing the issue
Whether the kit was modified and whether it happens in a clean place

No version label? Include the download date and source link.

Using an agent? Download report-kit-issue.txt attached to this post and give it to your agent. It will gather the details into a report you can review and post here. Remove secrets from logs.

requestGuide.title: How to request a UI
requestGuide.body:
Open one post per UI with a descriptive title. Include:

A reference source or link
A clear screenshot of every frame or panel you want copied, including its important states
A full walkthrough video showing animations, opening and closing, hover and click feedback, scrolling, and transitions
What you want recreated and any changes
Target devices and behavior the video does not show

Attach the video or provide a viewable link. A still image or teaser is not enough. Both the video and screenshots are required.

Only share references you have permission to share; do not upload paid source files. Requests are suggestions, not delivery promises.

showcaseGuide.title: Show what you made
showcaseGuide.body:
Create one post per project. Include a screenshot or video, the kit name and version, what you changed, and the feedback you want.

Choose Work in progress or Released. Keep updates together in your post, and give useful feedback on other builds.

Share the work; keep unrelated promotion out.
